name: transcribe-so
description: Transcribe audio and video (YouTube, podcasts, meetings, uploads) into speaker-labelled transcripts with chapters, cited Q&A, word timings, subtitles, and hosted captioned clips.

interface.shortDescription: Find who said what, and exactly when, in any video, podcast or meeting
interface.longDescription: Transcribe YouTube videos, podcasts, meetings and uploaded files into speaker-labelled, timestamped transcripts. Search across transcripts for who said what and jump to the moment, ask cited questions, and export chapters, subtitles, social captions and captioned clips. Quotes are free; your agent shows the price and waits for your approval before starting a paid job.
defaultPrompt: Transcribe this YouTube video and list the chapters with timestamps
Find who said what about pricing in my transcripts, with timestamps
Write Instagram captions for my latest episode
